newsitem.title: FINLAND: YIT SETS 61 MARKKA ISSUE PRICE. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: YIT SETS 61 MARKKA ISSUE PRICE. [CORRECTED 15:55 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects price in headline to 61 markka from FIM 61 mln.)

Finnish construction group YIT-Yhtyma said in a statement on Monday it had decided based on strong institutional demand to issue 4.88 million new shares at 61.00 markka each to institutional and private investors.
"The issue prices were confirmed at 61 markka in the issue to institutions and the public, and at 56 markka in the personnel issue," YIT said.

Institutional subscriptions totalled 2.5 times the originally planned issue of four million shares and of the 4.88 new shares, 4.08 million would go to institutions, 700,000 to the public and 100,000 to the personnel, it said.
